title: Hermann Oberth's 1954 UFO lecture notes
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Hermann Oberth's 1954 UFO lecture notes, about 1954 at Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
I have his notes and his
lecture notes and there he mentions that he saw
numerous radar measurements of their
speeds up to 19 km per second,

plain: A researcher named Kevin Knuth says he has the notes from a 1954 lecture in Germany by Hermann Oberth, an early rocket scientist who is named alongside his fellow rocket man Wernher von Braun. According to Knuth, Oberth wrote that he had seen many radar readings of unknown objects moving at up to 19 kilometres per second. If that is true, a founder of rocketry took UFO speeds seriously, and they were far beyond anything humans could build at the time.
